svg.title: dan@dlk25: a terminal session
svg.desc: whoami: Dan, developer at Bas Kommunikasjon in Oslo, Norway. He turns marketing problems into code: email templates, CRM journeys, the web pages around them and small tools. Projects: touchtype, gamesounds and dlk25.com. Then buddy, a small pixel figure, walks in and waves.

g.text: dan · developer at Bas Kommunikasjon · Oslo, Norway
I turn marketing problems into code: email templates, CRM journeys,
the web pages around them, and the small tools that get a campaign
out the door without anyone copying and pasting at midnight.
Side projects in the evenings, with Claude Code as a pair.
hi. the rest is at dlk25.com
